Subject of the Ministry's information-reception duty (risk-classification notices); state administration, not a customer requirement.

State-management duty of the Ministry of Science and Technology regarding conformity assessment of AI systems; government administrative mandate, not a customer requirement.

State-management duty of the Ministry of Science and Technology to manage/coordinate shared AI infrastructure and to coordinate opinions on AI infrastructure investment projects; government administrative mandate, not a customer requirement.
State-management duty of the Ministry of Science and Technology to organize the controlled testing mechanism for AI systems; government administrative mandate, not a customer requirement.
State-management duty of the Ministry of Science and Technology to organize AI development support mechanisms; government administrative mandate, not a customer requirement.

State-management duty of the Ministry of Science and Technology to build and submit to the Government regulations on the financial mechanism and operation of the National AI Development Fund; ministerial rulemaking, not a customer requirement.
State inspection/enforcement duty of the Ministry of Science and Technology (inspection, complaints, denunciations, violation handling); state authority, not a customer requirement.
Ministerial rulemaking duty of the Ministry of Science and Technology to issue common standards, regulations and guidelines for AI systems; not a customer requirement.

State-management duty of the Ministry of Science and Technology to guide the periodic information/reporting regime on AI development, application and management; government administrative mandate, not a customer requirement.

Article 42 establishes the Ministry of Public Security's responsibilities to coordinate state management of AI in areas of national security, social order, cybersecurity and data protection; governmental administrative duty, not a customer requirement.

Clause 1 assigns the Ministry of Public Security a state duty to preside over and coordinate detection, prevention, investigation and handling of violations exploiting AI systems; this is state law-enforcement power, not a customer requirement.

Clause 2 imposes on the Ministry of Public Security a state duty to organize construction, operation and provision of AI infrastructure for centralized state management at national data centers and to give opinions on state agencies' investment projects; state-management duty, not a customer requirement.

Clause 3 designates the Ministry of Public Security as managing agency responsible for building, managing and operating the National Database on AI at the National Data Center; state-management duty, not a customer requirement.

Clause 4 makes the Ministry of Public Security preside over development of cybersecurity standards and issuance of technical regulations for critical AI application infrastructure; ministerial rulemaking power, not a customer requirement.

Clause 5 assigns the Ministry of Public Security a state duty to verify and handle serious AI incidents affecting national security or social order and to coordinate on causes and remedial measures; state enforcement duty, not a customer requirement.

Clause 6 makes the Ministry of Public Security review and propose AI systems in the security/order field for inclusion in the high-risk AI system list; state-management duty, not a customer requirement.

Clause 7 requires the Ministry of Public Security to coordinate with the Ministry of Science and Technology in implementing the controlled testing mechanism and other decree contents; state coordination duty, not a customer requirement.

Clause 8 makes the Ministry of Public Security and the Ministry of Finance issue economic-technical norms for AI data activities as a basis for state budget management; ministerial rulemaking, not a customer requirement.
Clause 9 makes the Ministry of Public Security compile and submit to the Prime Minister lists of datasets for AI development in essential fields; state-management duty, not a customer requirement.

Chapeau of Article 43 introducing the responsibilities of ministries, ministerial-level agencies and other Government-authority agencies while performing their functions; non-operative state-management context detailed in clauses, not a customer requirement.

State agencies' rulemaking power: ministries must review and promulgate or submit normative legal documents, standards and national technical regulations detailing AI safety, risk management and deployment conditions; ministerial rulemaking authority, not a customer requirement.
State inspectorate/enforcement power: ministries organize inspection, examination and supervision of AI system deployment in managed sectors; state control authority, not a customer requirement.

State administrative mandate: ministries receive, appraise and issue written approvals for participation in the controlled testing mechanism for level 1 and level 2 AI systems and coordinate with the Ministry of Science and Technology on professional suitability appraisal; administrative processing duty of state organs, not a customer requirement.

Internal state management duty: ministries collect, build, assure quality, label, annotate, standardize, manage and exploit AI-serving databases, build and operate AI infrastructure for state management, and ensure connection and sharing with the National Database on AI; internal state operations, not a customer requirement.

State management duty: ministries integrate AI development goals into sector strategies and plans and prioritize resources and use of AI products/services in state management and public service delivery; state internal management function, not a customer requirement.
Article chapeau assigns state management over AI to provincial People's Committees and lists their responsibilities; government administrative role, not a customer requirement.
Duty of provincial People's Committee to issue and organize implementation of local AI development programs/plans; government administrative mandate, not a customer requirement.

Duty of provincial People's Committee to coordinate with the Ministry of Science and Technology on implementing AI regulations; inter-governmental coordination obligation, not a customer requirement.
